intent: CI builds and tests on JDK 21 and 25
add the GitHub Actions build workflow

title: run the build on a JDK 21 and JDK 25 matrix
why: The code compiles with --release 21, but the tool runs on newer JDKs too, and the cache choice differs by JDK (AppCDS on 21, AOT on 25). PR 24 states that running both JDKs catches behaviour differences early. Several tests adapt to the running JDK, so each matrix leg exercises a different cache path.
alternative: Build on a single JDK. The PR does not record this as considered, so the alternative is unknown.

name: Build workflow
role: GitHub Actions job that runs mvn verify on every push to main and on every pull request, once per JDK in the matrix (Temurin 21 and 25, Maven cache on)
conditions: Job names are mvn verify (JDK 21) and mvn verify (JDK 25); branch protection on main requires exactly these names

subject: Required check names
why: The branch protection rule on main lists the check names mvn verify (JDK 21) and mvn verify (JDK 25). If the job name or the matrix changes, the required check never reports and pull requests cannot merge until the rule is updated.
